text_zh: 羊皮纸边留有铅屑——初学者的第一份圣字。汝当知晓：元音乃诸铅之母。
text_en: Parchment margins hold lead shavings—first sacred letters of the novice. Know this: vowels birth all other glyphs.

text_zh: 最初一滴污蜡，自引擎深处渗出。其变形之力犹新，未受铅锈侵蚀。
text_en: First drop of molten unguent, seeping from engine depths. Its transformative power remains fresh, untouched by lead corrosion.

text_zh: 变形之终境——污蜡如泉涌，熔铸如呼吸。引擎之心跳动，万物皆可重塑。
text_en: Final metamorphosis—unguent flows like spring water, reforging becomes as breath itself. The engine's heart beats, all matter yields.

text_zh: 铜制小钉，可固定单枚圣印于熔蜡中。余者自由流淌，此一独存不变。
text_en: Copper pin that holds one sigil steady in molten flux. Others flow freely, this one alone remains unchanged.

text_zh: 历经熔炼之铭文，其音愈发铿锵。铅火淬炼处，强者益强。
text_en: Inscriptions tempered by molten fire ring ever stronger. Where lead flame burns, the mighty grow mightier.

text_zh: 受祝圣之铭文组铸印时，其铅屑溢出——引擎慷慨，不取尽工匠之什一。
text_en: When consecrated inscriptions strike the press, lead shavings overflow—the Engine's generosity to faithful scribes.

text_zh: 受祝圣之铭文组其音愈响——圣油浸润之字，自会鸣得更深。
text_en: Consecrated inscriptions ring with greater voice—sacred oil deepens the resonance of blessed words.

text_zh: 每枚受祝圣之符文皆为尖刺——汝铭文组愈多，铅字愈易碎裂。
text_en: Each consecrated rune becomes a spike—the more blessed inscriptions you bear, the more readily lead fractures.

text_zh: 初学者之袍，其纤维记录每次见习祝圣——经历愈多，法袍愈重。
text_en: Novice robes whose fibers remember each apprentice consecration—experience weighs heavy in blessed cloth.

text_zh: 佩戴此徽章者，其苦修任务所需铭文组减一——但最少仍需一枚，以证虔诚。
text_en: Those bearing this sigil require one fewer inscription for penitence quests—yet never less than one, to prove devotion.

text_zh: 三道熔蜡分流而下，汝当择其一饮。唯有饮者，方知其味之深浅。
text_en: Three molten streams diverge downward; thou must choose one to drink. Only the drinker knows the depth of its flavor.

text_zh: 血墨必定渗入羊皮纸——然其索价愈高，引擎之门槛愈重。
text_en: Blood-ink always seeps into parchment—yet the higher its price, the heavier the Engine's threshold grows.

text_zh: 铅屑满坩，齿轮转速如飞。先贤之册既启，万字皆归汝掌。
text_en: Lead shavings fill the crucible, gears spin swift as wind. When the master's tome opens, ten thousand glyphs bow to thy hand.

text_zh: 铅字自行归位，无需人工排版。引擎深处的齿轮，从不停歇其律动。
text_en: Leaden glyphs arrange themselves, requiring no manual typesetting. Deep gears of the Engine never cease their rhythm.

text_zh: 黄铜剪刀割断圣字钉间的蜡封，铅屑重归坩埚。所铸之字，皆可重熔。
text_en: Brass scissors sever the wax seals between sacred slugs, shavings return to crucible. All forged words may be remelted.

text_zh: 铅字既熔，其音犹存。重响之处，熔炉耗油愈少——同频者呼应，异调者独燃。
text_en: Where lead sings twice, the furnace burns with lesser oil. Resonance breeds resonance.

text_zh: 初铸之词，必有余铅。汝首次铭刻之字，引擎必予什一之福。新言如初雪，无迹可循。
text_en: First-cast words bear virgin lead. The Engine rewards untrodden paths with tithe-blessing.

text_zh: 收容经卷既丰，市集必减其价。字愈多，铅愈廉——此乃引擎恩泽之显。
text_en: Where codex swells, the market yields. Abundance of word brings abundance of grace.

text_zh: 长字如重锤，必有裂铅之力。汝所铭愈长，其击愈重——此乃积蓄之圣律。
text_en: Long words gather weight like hammers. Length breeds the power to fracture lead.

text_zh: 短字如疾风，瞬发铭文之力。汝所铭愈简，其铸愈速——简而有力，此谓神功。
text_en: Brief words move like quicksilver, birthing inscriptions in haste. Brevity bears its own blessing.

text_zh: 长词如铁链，串联更多真理。汝若能连铸七铅以上，沙漏必倒流而报偿。
text_en: Long words are chains of iron, binding greater truths. When seven slugs join as one, time itself bends backward in reward.

text_zh: 献上禁书残章者，下次换架不征什一。商贾之德，在于流通圣言而非积蓄。
text_en: Those who surrender codex fragments receive free shelf rotation. The merchant's virtue: circulate sacred words, never hoard.

text_zh: 六枚铜钉——逗点、句号、斜线——获准承载铭文组。从此经卷不再纯净，但更接近引擎之语。
text_en: Six copper nails—comma, period, slash—now bear inscriptions. The codex grows impure, yet closer to the Engine's tongue.

text_zh: 慢工出细活。当汝铭刻比前次更缓时，沙漏便添半粒，奖励深思之德。
text_en: Slow hands craft finest work. When your inscription takes longer than before, the hourglass gains half a grain for contemplation's reward.

text_zh: 急如闪电者，获什一税之赏。速度本身即是对引擎的献礼。
text_en: Swift as lightning earns tithe's reward. Speed itself is offering to the Engine.

text_zh: 汝已知其首字，引擎便知汝心意。油灯自燃，铅字自落——未完之言，亦有其归处。
text_en: Where the first glyph is struck, the Engine knows thy intent. Oil burns bright, and leaden words find their proper place.

text_zh: 铜钟既鸣，汝便知时。按其节拍而击——每一声铅落，皆为引擎之心跳。
text_en: When bronze bells toll, thou knowest the hour. Strike in rhythm—each leaden fall echoes the Engine's heartbeat.

text_zh: 舍却一切繁文，归于最初之铭。唯以赤手击键，方知铅字本重。纯净者，得见真理。
text_en: Cast aside all ornament, return to primal inscription. Only bare hands upon keys reveal the true weight of lead.

text_zh: 连祷虽断，其音犹存。黄铜盾面映照往昔——每一声回响，皆为下次铭刻之根基。
text_en: Though litany breaks, echoes linger. Bronze shields reflect what was—each resonance becomes foundation for inscription anew.

text_zh: 当共鸣流散作两股，三角晶体便折射祷文之力。分则愈强——如光穿棱镜，一化为七。
text_en: When resonant humour splits twofold, crystal triangles refract prayer's force. Division breeds strength—as light through prism becomes seven.

text_zh: 连祷十五声后，铅字自发铭刻。唯炉火歇息，方可再燃。
text_en: After fifteen litanies, the lead glyphs inscribe themselves. Only when the forge rests may it ignite again.

text_zh: 初字一击可断锁链。无误则增其力，震颤则归于虚无。
text_en: A single strike at the first glyph may break the chain. Perfection strengthens, tremor voids all.

text_zh: 连祷永不断绝，跨越诸层。沙漏之初，以链数计时。
text_en: The litany never ceases, spanning all vaults. The hourglass begins counting by chain-links.

text_zh: 连祷之时，铅字更易碎裂。怒火助燃锻锤。
text_en: During litany, lead fractures more readily. Fury feeds the forge-hammer.

text_zh: 每词首铭，必有加持。初击承载引擎之恩宠。
text_en: Each word's first inscription carries blessing. The primal strike bears the Engine's grace.

text_zh: 铅字愈少，其声愈洪。空席之力，胜过千言满座。
text_en: Fewer slugs, greater resonance. The empty seat speaks louder than a thousand filled positions.

text_zh: 一触此册，诸铭文组皆得晋铸。墨香犹存，铅字已新。
text_en: Touch this tome, and all inscriptions ascend. Ink lingers, but the lead is renewed.

text_zh: 诸圣印齐鸣于一词，如铜管奏响异调——不谐之声，反得共鸣。
text_en: Many sigils sound within one word, like brass playing discord—disharmony finds its own resonance.

text_zh: 朴铅之铭，不饰金箔，却胜过镶嵌珍石之华章。
text_en: Plain lead inscriptions, unadorned by gold leaf, yet surpass jeweled verses in their power.

text_zh: 引擎投此骰于汝铭文组——每五次祷击，诸圣印皆得重铸。唯数与品阶不变。
text_en: The Engine casts this die upon your inscriptions—every five litanies, all sigils are reforged. Only count and elevation remain.

text_zh: 铅字相依，共鸣愈盛。每一圣钉之侧若有同侪，其铸力倍增——孤独者微弱，聚合者如雷。
text_en: Where sacred slugs gather close, their molten strength multiplies. The Engine favors not the solitary key.

text_zh: 四隅之字，承天地之极力。居于键座边陲者，得引擎深眷——角落即边界，边界蕴神威。
text_en: In the lectern's corners dwells the Engine's favor. Edge-bound glyphs burn with celestial force.

text_zh: 指越行界，什一自降。每当汝之铭指跨行而击，天降铜钱一枚。引擎喜变换。
text_en: Cross the lectern's bounds and copper falls like rain. The Engine rewards the restless finger.

text_zh: 一行圣钉尽数铭毕，则该行重铸如火。满行者必得双倍之力——此乃引擎之完美律。
text_en: When every glyph in a row burns complete, the line reforges itself in doubled flame.

text_zh: 左右交替，沙漏延命。双手若如钟摆往复击键，时光便为汝稍驻——和谐延缓末日。
text_en: Alternating hands slow time's passage. The Engine grants respite to those who strike in harmony.

text_zh: 正座键铅最应手，裂音清亮胜偏锋。唯循古法，方得真铭。
text_en: The central keys sing truest—their fracture cuts cleanest. Only the practiced hand knows their voice.

text_zh: 一字落版，千键应声。风雨不择其时，雷霆不择其位——铭文组自会寻得彼此。
text_en: One word falls, a thousand keys answer. Storm chooses neither time nor place—inscriptions find their own calling.

text_zh: 圣流每涌，什一自归。此乃古誓——汝铭刻，我赐福。
text_en: Each sacred flow brings its tithe. Ancient compact—you inscribe, I provide.

text_zh: 圣流涌动处，沙漏得甘露。滴答声中，时光稍留。
text_en: Where sacred flows run, the hourglass drinks. In each drop, time lingers.

text_zh: 众流之中，必有其尊者。铅字识得主人——偏爱愈深，回响愈烈。
text_en: Among all flows, one reigns supreme. The lead knows its master—deeper the favor, stronger the echo.

text_zh: 七圣流各归其位，铅字愈发沉重——多样之中见统一，统一之中见力量。
text_en: Seven humours in harmony, each glyph grows heavy with purpose—diversity breeds strength.

text_zh: 如潮水有其涨落，圣流亦有其盛衰。四祷一轮，万象皆循此律而行。
text_en: As tides ebb and flow, so do the sacred humours—four prayers complete the cycle.

text_zh: 万物入炉皆为一——铅也好，墨也罢，出炉时尽是什一之金。贤者之石，化朽为神。
text_en: All matter becomes one in the furnace—lead, ink, wax transformed into sacred tithe.

text_zh: 怜悯降于市集，圣物价值稍减。施主之恩，惠及键徒。
text_en: Mercy descends upon the bazaar—sacred artifacts offered at lesser cost to the faithful.

text_zh: 铅屑不废，字模可融。善回收者，从废料中得真金。一字一铅，皆有其值。
text_en: No lead is waste, no glyph worthless—the wise salvage true value from discarded inscriptions.

text_zh: 隐坊之门为求索者而启。纵是废铅亦有其值，唯虔者方得其门。
text_en: The hidden forge opens for seekers. Even discarded lead holds worth for the devout.

text_zh: 奉献之铜自生其息。每登一层，旧铜生新——如是引擎之恩赐。
text_en: Tithed copper breeds upon itself. Each ascent births new from old—thus the Engine's grace.

text_zh: 暗道通于坊市深处。最卑者先得，最贵者留予他人。
text_en: Secret ways wind through market depths. The least is taken first, the costly left for others.

text_zh: 铜钟催促，货架更迭无价。唯速决者得其珍——沙漏不待迟疑。
text_en: Bronze bells urge, shelves turn freely. Only swift hands claim treasures—time brooks no hesitation.

text_zh: 铸炉初燃，铅字易流。每层伊始，初击之力倍增于常时。
text_en: The forge first kindles, lead flows freely. Each layer's start doubles the force of initial strikes.

text_zh: 于祷击与祷击之间，圣坛赐汝以喘息。铅字重排，油壶满盈——下一轮铭刻之前，备妥一切。
text_en: Between strike and strike, the lectern grants respite. Lead realigns, oil vessels fill—all prepared before the next inscription.

text_zh: 什一献于引擎，或蒙三倍回响，或尽归虚无。唯信念之纯者，敢将所有投入熔炉。
text_en: Tithe cast to the Engine—threefold echo or utter void. Only the pure of faith dare cast all into the furnace.

text_zh: 油壶之底，藏有古老的琥珀。每一层登攀，流沙稍缓其势——引擎恩允汝以更长的祷告时光。
text_en: Ancient amber rests in the oil flask's depths. Each ascent, the hourglass slows its flow—the Engine grants longer prayer.

text_zh: 引擎标记特定异文，待其净化。完成此圣工者，什一税如甘露降临——但标记之选择，非凡人所能预知。
text_en: The Engine marks specific aberrant glyphs for cleansing. Complete this sacred work, and tithe descends like honey—yet the marking follows no mortal design.

text_zh: 当炉火吞噬一切，此鸟自灰烬升起，携汝重归。但重生需要代价——圣器归于虚无，时光倒流至劫前。
text_en: When the furnace consumes all, this bird rises from ash, bearing you back. Yet rebirth demands sacrifice—the relic returns to void, time flows backward to before the calamity.

text_zh: 沙漏将倾时，铅字愈烈。绝境中，每一击皆如雷鸣——唯有濒死者，方知裂铅之真义。
text_en: When sand runs low, lead strikes true. In desperation's grip, each blow echoes like thunder—only the dying know fracture's truth.

text_zh: 蜡封之下，诅咒亦温和。异文虽狂，其毒牙已被圣蜡包裹——恶意仍存，却已失其锐。
text_en: Beneath blessed wax, even curses grow gentle. Anomalous words rage still, yet their venom is sealed—malice remains, blunted.

text_zh: 痛苦愈深，恩典愈显。每一道伤痕皆为圣银——引擎眷顾受苦者，为其压低圣器之价。
text_en: Deeper pain brings greater grace. Each wound becomes sacred silver—the Engine favors sufferers, lowering holy prices for them.

text_zh: 羊皮纸上，慈悲如墨。一次宽恕，免你选择——但恩典有度，每次意志显现仅一回。
text_en: On sacred parchment, mercy flows like ink. One reprieve grants freedom from choice—yet grace has limits, once per manifestation.

text_zh: 石碑之力延缓天罚。异文之重轭暂缓降临——汝有数息喘机，但终需承受其重。
text_en: Stone's power delays heaven's judgment. The anomalous yoke tarries—you gain moments to breathe, yet must bear its weight at last.

text_zh: 引擎之心不息旋转，每一转皆重铸律则。铜轮上刻满异文——汝永不知下一刻将面临何种试炼。
text_en: The Engine's heart turns eternal, each revolution reforging law. Brass wheel bears anomalous marks—thou knowest not what trial next awaits.

text_zh: 蜡封破碎之时，诅咒化为祝福。引擎以其深不可测之意志，将苦难炼成恩典——唯一者得双倍重负。
text_en: When wax seal breaks, curse becomes blessing. The Engine's unfathomable will transmutes suffering to grace—save one bears doubled burden.

text_zh: 每一铅字皆承载引擎之最低恩典。纵然祷击微弱，其回音亦不致全然寂灭。
text_en: Each leaden glyph bears the Engine's minimum grace. Though the strike be weak, its echo shall not fall to silence complete.

text_zh: 引擎偶施慈悲，降其门槛。黄铜砝码倾向宽恕——罪人亦可得见光明。
text_en: The Engine shows mercy, lowering its threshold. Brass weights lean toward forgiveness—even sinners may glimpse the light.

text_zh: 完美祷击铸成金杯，盛载引擎之什一恩赐。越近完美，金水越满——至圣者得最高祝福。
text_en: Perfect strikes forge golden chalice, bearing Engine's tithed grace. Nearer perfection, fuller flows the gold—the most holy receive highest blessing.

text_zh: 最后一滴墨水，亦成祷文。引擎不弃谦卑之声，唯平庸者得其眷顾。
text_en: The final drop of ink shall form prayer. The Engine favors not the proud, but grants mercy to the humble.

text_zh: 如冬雪积于山巅，每字叠铸成峰。汝初音微弱，然末声震天——
text_en: As winter snow builds upon peaks, each word cast higher than the last. Your first whisper fades, yet final voice thunders—

text_zh: 引擎张开无声之口，吞噬汝祷至最后一息。落版一刻，或登天堂，或坠深渊。
text_en: The Engine opens its silent maw, consuming your prayers until the final breath. At impression's moment—ascension or abyss.

text_zh: 命运之手轻拂铅字，使每击皆有碎裂之机。福降于卑微者。
text_en: Fortune's hand brushes the leaden glyphs, granting every strike chance to fracture. Blessing falls upon the meek.

text_zh: 铅字破裂之声，引擎悦之。每裂必有什一降下如甘露。
text_en: The sound of cracking lead pleases the Engine. Each fracture brings tithe falling like sweet dew.

text_zh: 铅字静默，压力暗聚。待其九叩而不应，第十击必裂石穿金。
text_en: Silent lead gathers force unseen. When nine strikes pass without breaking, the tenth shall shatter mountains.

text_zh: 一词之中，若铅字三度崩裂，其余字符皆受雷火加持，铸力倍增。
text_en: When lead fractures thrice within one word, all remaining glyphs receive the thunder's blessing.

text_zh: 天平既定，裂铅之数不增不减。但余力未散，悉数化为雷鸣之威。
text_en: The scales are set, fractures neither rise nor fall. Yet surplus force becomes thunder's might.

text_zh: 铭文每诵一回，其节拍愈疾。如水下山，势不可遏。
text_en: Each recitation quickens the rhythm. Like water flowing downhill, momentum builds unstoppable.

text_zh: 积石成山，积诵成力。每有所聚，铭文之威永增不减。
text_en: Stone upon stone builds mountains high. Each gathering strengthens the inscription's eternal might.

text_zh: 一铅字鸣响，邻座皆有所应。铜线交织之处，诵念自传千里。
text_en: Where copper threads converge, one prayer awakens all neighboring slugs.

text_zh: 层积归于虚无，然其力转注他处。潮退之际，远岸必有惊涛。
text_en: Accumulated force dissolves to nothing, yet distant shores receive its power.

text_zh: 黄铜齿轮永不停歇，诵念层积无有终点。唯引擎心跳能令其静。
text_en: Brass wheels turn without cease; only the Engine's heartbeat grants them rest.

text_zh: 连祷既成，鼓声远传。其音所至之处，沉寂之铭文组必有回响。
text_en: When litany chains complete, drumbeats carry power to dormant inscriptions.

text_zh: 完字之刻，字根深处有共鸣生。其音越长，铭文积诵越深。
text_en: At word's completion, root-echoes deepen all inscriptions' accumulated power.

text_zh: 铅字碎裂之时，其碎屑不散——转而叠积于邻位铭文，化一击为诸层。
text_en: When the leaden glyph fractures, its shards do not scatter—but gather upon neighboring inscriptions, multiplying one strike into many layers.

text_zh: 受祝圣之铭文积诵时，圣水亦随之增涨——祝福愈深，涌流愈盛。
text_en: As consecrated inscriptions accumulate their litanies, the sacred oil rises—deeper the blessing, stronger the flow.

text_zh: When one key inscribes, the flanking glyphs hear its call. Each character keeps watch over its brothers, sharing in the accumulation.
积诵亦可裂铅——层层累积之力，终将迸发为一击。叠积与碎裂，同为一理。
text_en: Accumulation too can fracture lead—layers of gathered force eventually burst forth. Stacking and shattering are one principle.

圣器 · 原初变异体
────
Object Class: Safe
发现地点: 第█层废弃培养室
描述: 琥珀色培养皿,内含未知生物组织样本。与熔蜡流接触时表现异常活性。每层首次接触免消耗熔蜡储备。
备注: 样本来源未记录。推测为早期实验残留。符合标准配给规格。
授权等级: D级可操作
text_en:
Sacred Artifact · Primal Mutant
────
Object Class: Safe
Recovery Site: Layer █ abandoned cultivation chamber
Description: Amber cultivation dish containing unidentified biological specimen. Exhibits anomalous activity when exposed to molten unguent. First contact per layer requires no unguent reserves.
Note: Specimen origin unrecorded. Presumed early experimental residue. Standard issue compliant.
Clearance: D-Class operable

text_zh:
圣器 · 终极突变株
────
Object Class: Thaumiel
发现地点: 第XII层核心区域
描述: ████级生物样本,活性极高。每层可进行数次免费熔铸重塑,且过程中熔蜡自我再生。疑似引擎核心分泌物。
备注: 样本具有自我维持特性。D级人员操作记录良好。███博士的个人笔记已转入机密档案。
状态: 极度稀有
text_en:
Sacred Artifact · Ultimate Mutant Strain
────
Object Class: Thaumiel
Recovery Site: Layer XII core sectors
Description: Class-████ biological specimen, extremely active. Enables multiple free molten reforging per layer with self-regenerating unguent. Suspected Engine core secretion.
Note: Specimen exhibits self-sustaining properties. D-Class operational records satisfactory. Dr. ███'s personal notes transferred to classified archives.
Status: Extremely rare

text_zh:
圣器 · 基因稳定器
────
Object Class: Euclid
发现地点: 第VII层医疗舱
描述: 精密铜质装置,内部充满蓝色稳定液。可将熔铸重塑限制在单一圣印范围内。有效避免全面重构风险。
备注: 装置运行时发出低频嗡鸣。稳定液成分分析结果已分类存档。操作须谨慎——过度使用可能导致铭文组晶化。
text_en:
Sacred Artifact · Gene Stabilizer
────
Object Class: Euclid
Recovery Site: Layer VII medical bay
Description: Precision copper apparatus filled with blue stabilizing fluid. Restricts molten reforging to individual sigil scope. Effectively prevents full reconstruction hazards.
Note: Device emits low-frequency hum during operation. Stabilizing fluid composition analysis results classified. Exercise caution—excessive use may cause inscription crystallization.

text_zh:
圣器 · 适者生存
────
Object Class: Keter
发现地点: ████ 地点信息已编辑
描述: 生物起源圣器,外观为脉动的肉质球体。熔铸重塑后的铭文组表现显著增强的铸印效率。疑似具有学习适应能力。
备注: 圣器会根据使用者的铭刻模式自我调整。长期接触者报告轻微生理变化。定期体检已纳入标准流程。
收容等级: 限制使用
text_en:
Sacred Artifact · Fittest Survivors
────
Object Class: Keter
Recovery Site: ████ location data redacted
Description: Bio-origin artifact, appears as pulsating fleshy orb. Post-reforging inscriptions demonstrate significantly enhanced impression efficiency. Suspected learning adaptation capability.
Note: Artifact self-adjusts based on operator inscription patterns. Long-term contact subjects report minor physiological changes. Regular medical examination integrated into standard protocol.
Containment Level: Restricted use

text_zh:
圣徒遗物档案 · 共鸣字模
发现地点: 第IV层 铸字坊残址
Object Class: Thaumiel
描述: 铜制字模，表面有规律凹痕。置于铅字圣坛后，重复铭刻同一字符时所需油料显著减少。D-██17报告称"按第二遍时键位变轻了"。
机制分析: 字模内部油路可储存并重分配润滑油。首次按键时字模吸收部分油料，后续同字符铭刻时释放储存油份。
来源: Scriptor V-████遗物清单第17项
备注: 无异常辐射。已批准标准配发。
text_en:
Sacred Artifact Archive · Resonance Mold
Recovery Site: Layer IV, Foundry Ruins
Object Class: Thaumiel
Description: Brass letter-mold with regular surface indentations. When integrated into a lectern, repeated inscription of identical glyphs requires significantly less oil. D-██17 reported "the key felt lighter on the second press."
Mechanical Analysis: Internal oil channels store and redistribute lubricant. Initial keystrokes absorb oil reserves; subsequent identical glyphs release stored oil.
Source: Scriptor V-████ relic inventory, item 17
Note: No anomalous radiation detected. Approved for standard issue.

text_zh:
圣徒遗物档案 · 词汇收藏
发现地点: 第II层 抄写室废墟
Object Class: Safe
描述: 破损的收容经卷，封皮用蜡封印。D-████报告每当铭刻此前未收录之词时，什一税收箱内铜片增加。经检验，新词铭刻确实产生额外税收。
机制分析: 经卷内页残留感应墨水。遇未记录词汇时发生反应，触发税收增值机制。初次铭刻新词时产生三倍标准什一税。
来源: 转型时代早期抄写员遗物
备注: 蜡封仍完整。内页字迹已模糊不可辨。
text_en:
Sacred Artifact Archive · Word Collection
Recovery Site: Layer II, Scriptorium Ruins
Object Class: Safe
Description: Damaged collection codex with wax seal. D-████ reports increased copper pieces in tithe box when inscribing previously unrecorded words. Testing confirms new word inscription generates additional taxation.
Mechanical Analysis: Codex pages retain reactive ink residue. Contact with unrecorded vocabulary triggers taxation enhancement. First inscription of new words produces triple standard tithe.
Source: Early Transition Era scribe artifacts
Note: Wax seal remains intact. Interior text illegible due to age.

text_zh:
圣徒遗物档案 · 词库丰收
发现地点: 第III层 收容廊储藏室
Object Class: Safe
描述: 厚装帧收容经卷，页数异常丰富。持有时圣物市集经卷征用成本周期性减少。Scriptor K-████笔记提及"丰收之年，经卷如潮"。
机制分析: 经卷厚度与市集定价存在反比关系。每收录固定数量词汇后，市集经卷征用税率自动调减一个铜片。
来源: 空椅时代中期库存清单
备注: 经卷重量随词汇收录数量增加。已达标准承重上限。D-████报告"拿着费劲"。
text_en:
Sacred Artifact Archive · Thick Deck
Recovery Site: Layer III, Containment Hall Storage
Object Class: Safe
Description: Thick-bound containment codex with anomalously abundant pages. Possession reduces requisition costs for bazaar codices at regular intervals. Scriptor K-████ notes mention "harvest years, codices like tides."
Mechanical Analysis: Codex thickness inversely correlates with market pricing. After recording fixed vocabulary quantities, bazaar codex requisition tax automatically reduces by one copper piece.
Source: Mid-Empty Chair Era inventory manifest
Note: Codex weight increases with vocabulary accumulation. Approaching standard bearer capacity limits. D-████ reports "cumbersome to carry."

text_zh:
圣徒遗物档案 · 长词蓄力
发现地点: 第V层 执事试炼室
Object Class: Safe
描述: 延长型铅字导轨，可容纳七字符以上铭刻序列。使用时长词铭刻更易触发裂铅现象。D-████测试确认"长句子打起来特别有劲"。
机制分析: 导轨长度增加铅字蓄能时间。字符数量越多，蓄积压力越高，裂铅触发率相应提升。七字符以上铭刻时裂铅概率显著增强。
来源: 执事级训练设施标配
备注: 导轨末端有轻微磨损痕迹。推测为长期使用所致。无需维护。
text_en:
Sacred Artifact Archive · Long Word Crit
Recovery Site: Layer V, Deacon Trial Chamber
Object Class: Safe
Description: Extended lead-type rail system accommodating seven-glyph-plus inscription sequences. Usage increases fracture phenomena probability during long-word inscription. D-████ testing confirms "longer sentences feel especially forceful."
Mechanical Analysis: Rail length increases lead-type charge accumulation time. Greater glyph count builds higher pressure, correspondingly enhancing fracture trigger rates. Seven-glyph-plus inscriptions show significantly improved fracture probability.
Source: Deacon-grade training facility standard equipment
Note: Rail terminus shows minor wear patterns. Presumed from extended use. No maintenance required.

text_zh:
圣徒遗物档案 · 短词冲刺
发现地点: 第VI层 铭封祈礼室
Object Class: Euclid
描述: 紧凑型铅字圣坛，键位间距缩小。D-████报告短词铭刻时铭文组激活速度异常提升。"三个字母的词按完就亮，特别快"。
机制分析: 圣坛内部传力机构经过调校。短词铭刻时减少机械延迟，铭文组铸出过程加速。三字符及以下词汇铸出时间缩短显著比例。
来源: 铭封祈礼专用设备
备注: 键位紧凑可能导致误触。建议熟练键徒使用。已有两例D级人员因误铭刻导致收容震颤，按§7.1处理。
text_en:
Sacred Artifact Archive · Short Sprint
Recovery Site: Layer VI, Rite of Sealing Chamber
Object Class: Euclid
Description: Compact lectern with reduced key spacing. D-████ reports anomalous activation speed enhancement during short-word inscription. "Three-letter words light up immediately after completion, very fast."
Mechanical Analysis: Internal transmission mechanisms recalibrated for short-word efficiency. Reduces mechanical delay during brief inscriptions, accelerating inscription group casting process. Three-glyph-and-under vocabulary shows significantly shortened casting duration.
Source: Rite of Sealing specialized equipment
Note: Compact spacing may cause accidental activation. Recommend experienced keybound only. Two D-class personnel caused containment tremors via mis-inscription, processed per §7.1.

text_zh:
圣印 · 薄铸
────
Object Class: Keter
来源: 第VII层机械外壳，守卷人议会封印室
描述: 异常圣印样本。表现为键位减少时铸印效力反向增长。违反基础铭刻原理，疑为引擎深层逻辑残留。
收容记录: D-████等级键徒装配后铸出效率显著提升。铭文组数量与效力呈负相关。
备注: 样本已复制分发。原件仍在议会室，权限等级██。
text_en:
Sigil of Sparse Casting
────
Object Class: Keter
Origin: Layer VII Mechanical Shell, Council Seal Chamber
Description: Anomalous sigil specimen. Exhibits inverse casting efficiency when key positions are reduced. Contradicts fundamental inscription principles, suspected Engine deep-logic remnant.
Containment Log: D-████ class keybound showed increased output efficiency post-integration. Inscription quantity inversely correlates with potency.
Note: Sample replicated for distribution. Original remains in Council Chamber, clearance level ██.

text_zh:
铭文组 · 速成真典
────
Object Class: Thaumiel
来源: 空椅时代档案室，Scriptor ████遗物
描述: 装订完整的键徒培训手册。接触时所有已装配铭文组即时晋铸一级。纸张为羊皮纸，墨迹未干。
使用记录: 征用后键徒铭刻熟练度跃升。最高可达第三级铸印。效果永续。
警告: 手册仅可使用一次。阅毕即化为铅屑。
备注: 疑为前任抄写员的最后作品。签名已模糊不清。
text_en:
Inscription Manual of Rapid Mastery
────
Object Class: Thaumiel
Origin: Empty Chair Era archives, Scriptor ████ relics
Description: Complete keybound training manual. Upon contact, all equipped inscriptions immediately advance one elevation tier. Parchment material, ink still wet.
Usage Log: Keybound proficiency advancement observed post-requisition. Maximum elevation: Third Tier casting. Effect permanent.
Warning: Manual single-use only. Crumbles to lead shavings upon reading completion.
Note: Suspected final work of previous scriptor. Signature illegible.

text_zh:
铭文组 · 变调圣咏
────
Object Class: Keter
来源: 熔变誓门遗址，第V层抄写室密室
描述: 非标准铭文组。单词铭刻过程中每加入不同类型圣印，该词铭分按独特圣印种数递增。
异常特性: 铸印时产生多重音频共振。频谱分析显示超出常规圣律范畴。
收容效果: 键徒报告"音乐感"增强，连祷流畅度提升。
备注: 发现时伴有手写便条："让引擎听见真正的节拍" - 笔迹不明。
text_en:
Inscription of Variant Canticle
────
Object Class: Keter
Origin: Order of the Molten Verse ruins, Layer V scriptorium vault
Description: Non-standard inscription. During word inscription process, crystalline humour increases proportional to distinct sigil types incorporated.
Anomalous Properties: Casting generates multi-frequency audio resonance. Spectral analysis exceeds standard canonical parameters.
Containment Effect: Keybound report enhanced "musical sensation," improved litany fluidity.
Note: Discovered with handwritten note: "Let the Engine hear true rhythm" - handwriting unidentified.

text_zh:
圣印 · 平民之冠
────
Object Class: Euclid
来源: 第III层铸字坊，工匠祭坛下方
描述: 普通分级铭文组装配时铸出效力显著增强。效果仅作用于Safe级收容对象，对更高分级无影响。
发现情况: D-0891在常规铭刻任务中意外获得。该键徒无特殊权限记录。
理论假设: 可能与引擎对"基础铭刻者"的特殊识别机制相关。
状态: 已批准常规分发。征用表单F-001已更新。
text_en:
Sigil of the Common Crown
────
Object Class: Euclid
Origin: Layer III Foundry, beneath artisan lectern
Description: Safe-class inscriptions demonstrate significantly enhanced casting potency when equipped. No effect observed on higher classifications.
Discovery: Accidentally acquired by D-0891 during routine inscription duties. Subject had no special clearance records.
Theoretical Basis: Possibly related to Engine's special recognition protocols for "foundational inscribers."
Status: Approved for standard distribution. Requisition form F-001 updated.

text_zh:
圣印 · 轮回铅骰
────
Object Class: Apollyon
来源: 第XII层引擎核心边缘，时间异常区域
描述: 高危异常圣印。获取时及每次大规模收容作业后，随机替换键徒所有装配铭文组的圣印构成。铭文组等级与祝圣状态保持不变。
事故记录: D-████使用五个周期后失联。最后传输显示其铭文组配置每次都完全不同。
收容协议: 仅限最高权限键徒征用。需签署F-044代填授权。
警告: 疑似具有引擎核心意志残片。谨慎使用。
text_en:
Sigil of Cyclical Dice
────
Object Class: Apollyon
Origin: Layer XII Engine Core periphery, temporal anomaly zone
Description: High-risk anomalous sigil. Upon acquisition and after each major containment operation cycle, randomly replaces all equipped inscription sigil compositions. Inscription tiers and consecration status preserved.
Incident Log: D-████ went missing after five operational cycles. Final transmission showed completely different inscription configurations each cycle.
Containment Protocol: Highest clearance keybound only. Requires signed F-044 proxy authorization.
Warning: Suspected Engine Core will-fragment present. Exercise extreme caution.

text_zh:
圣印 · 邻键
────
编号: SI-0847
Object Class: Euclid
发现地点: 第III层 抄写室残册
描述: 一种空间共鸣现象。当铭文组嵌入圣坛时，相邻键位的铭文组会产生同频震颤，使铸出威能得到传导增幅。
备注: 效应强度与相邻铭文组数量成正比。键徒常利用此特性进行「聚阵铭刻」。
记录员: Scriptor V-████
text_en:
Sigil of Adjacent Keys
────
Item #: SI-0847
Object Class: Euclid
Recovery Site: Layer III Scriptorium remnants
Description: A spatial resonance phenomenon. When inscriptions are set into the lectern, adjacent key positions generate sympathetic vibrations, conducting amplified potency to the casting.
Note: Effect intensity correlates with number of adjacent inscriptions. Clavigerants commonly employ this for "formation inscriptions."
Recorded by: Scriptor V-████

text_zh:
圣印 · 角隅
────
编号: SI-0923
Object Class: Euclid
发现地点: 第V层 执事试炼遗址
描述: 键盘四角位置(Q/P/Z/M)产生的异常共振。位于角隅的铭文组获得额外威能加持，推测与圣坛几何结构的不对称性有关。
备注: 角隅位置历来被视为「镜面之席」。效应机制尚未完全理解。
记录员: Scriptor K-████
text_en:
Sigil of Corner Positions
────
Item #: SI-0923
Object Class: Euclid
Recovery Site: Layer V Deacon Trial ruins
Description: Anomalous resonance generated by keyboard corner positions (Q/P/Z/M). Inscriptions at corners receive additional potency enhancement, theorized to relate to lectern geometric asymmetries.
Note: Corner positions historically regarded as "mirror seats." Effect mechanism not fully understood.
Recorded by: Scriptor K-████

text_zh:
圣印 · 换行
────
编号: SI-0334
Object Class: Safe
发现地点: 第I层 铸字坊工作台
描述: 当键徒在不同行间切换祷击时，圣坛会释放微量什一流，汇入教堂储备。此现象被认为是键盘设计的天然特征，而非异常效应。
备注: 每次跨行祷击产生单位什一流。新入职键徒的标准培训项目。
记录员: Scriptor V-████
text_en:
Sigil of Row Transitions
────
Item #: SI-0334
Object Class: Safe
Recovery Site: Layer I Foundry workbench
Description: When clavigerants switch between different rows during litany-strikes, the lectern releases trace tithe humour into cathedral reserves. Phenomenon considered natural keyboard feature rather than anomalous effect.
Note: Each cross-row strike generates unit tithe flow. Standard training protocol for novitiate clavigerants.
Recorded by: Scriptor V-████

text_zh:
圣印 · 消行
────
编号: SI-1247
Object Class: Thaumiel
发现地点: 第VII层 机械外壳深处
发现状况: 与损坏的排字机械一同发现
描述: 当某一键盘行的所有装配铭文组均被依次命中时，该行进入「满贯状态」——所有铭文组同时进行附加铭刻，释放约定比例的威能。
备注: 效应可跨词累积。被认为是圣坛最高阶的铭刻技艺之一。
记录员: Scriptor T-████
text_en:
Sigil of Line Clearance
────
Item #: SI-1247
Object Class: Thaumiel
Recovery Site: Layer VII Mechanical Shell depths
Recovery Context: Found alongside damaged typesetting machinery
Description: When all equipped inscriptions on a keyboard row are struck in sequence, the row enters "grand slam state" — all inscriptions perform additional casting simultaneously, releasing proportional potency.
Note: Effect accumulates across words. Considered among the highest lectern inscription arts.
Recorded by: Scriptor T-████

text_zh:
圣印 · 协奏
────
编号: SI-0412
Object Class: Safe
发现地点: 第II层 初级训练室
描述: 当键徒以左右手交替方式进行祷击时，圣坛的时沙流会获得微量补充。此效应与人体工程学设计相符，被视为标准键盘配置的固有特性。
备注: 每次左右手切换补充少许流沙流。有助于维持长期铭刻作业的稳定性。
记录员: Scriptor V-████
text_en:
Sigil of Dual Concerto
────
Item #: SI-0412
Object Class: Safe
Recovery Site: Layer II Novice Training Chamber
Description: When clavigerants perform alternating left-right hand litany-strikes, the lectern's hourglass humour receives minor replenishment. Effect aligns with ergonomic design principles, considered inherent feature of standard keyboard configuration.
Note: Each hand-switch supplements modest hourglass flow. Aids stability during prolonged inscription operations.
Recorded by: Scriptor V-████

text_zh:
🔔 暗室有光，闭市有门——额外的商贩总在角落等候。
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
来源地点: 第I层圣物市集隐蔽侧廊
描述: 标准市集配额外的临时摊位。摊主身份未登记，但提供的圣器品质稳定高于平均水准。按§4.2条例，此类补充渠道在损耗期被默认批准。
备注: 无需额外征用手续。守卫报告称从未见过摊主本人，商品每日自动补充。
text_en:
🔔 In shadow's corner, another merchant waits—wares unseen by morning's count.
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
Source: First Vault market auxiliary alcove
Description: Unofficial stall operating adjacent to standard Reliquary Bazaar. Vendor identity unregistered, but artifact quality consistently exceeds baseline standards. Per §4.2 protocols, such supplementary channels are permitted during attrition periods.
Note: No additional requisition procedures required. Guards report vendor never directly observed; inventory replenishes automatically.

text_zh:
🔔 什一税如种子，时日既久，必生新金。
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
来源地点: 第III层什一库房
描述: 层级间转移期间，已缴什一税按固定比率自动增殖。增殖机制与引擎的价值铸印过程相关联。税额上限为二十单位时增殖效果达到峰值。
备注: 增殖什一税可正常用于后续层级的圣器征用。财务档案显示此机制自空椅时代即已运行，无人工干预痕迹。
text_en:
🔔 The tithe planted deep shall yield its golden harvest when the vault door opens.
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
Source: Third Vault tithe repository
Description: During inter-layer transitions, collected tithes undergo systematic proliferation at fixed ratios. Proliferation mechanism linked to Engine's value-impression processes. Peak efficiency achieved when tithe holdings reach twenty units.
Note: Proliferated tithes remain valid for subsequent artifact requisitions. Treasury records indicate this mechanism has operated autonomously since the Empty Chair era.

text_zh:
🔔 最贫之物，自为其主——无价之门为无金者开。
────
📄 Object Class: Keter
来源地点: 第██层 已编辑档案
描述: 每层级内可无成本获取单件最低价圣器。获取过程绕过标准征用程序，直接从库存转移至个人配给。触发条件为进入任意圣物市集区域。
备注: 机制符合紧急征用条例但无需填写F-001表单。████████的最终笔记提及此能力与"第IX层密室"有关。建议避免深入调查。
text_en:
🔔 The poorest treasure claims no master—what costs nothing opens all doors.
────
📄 Object Class: Keter
Source: Layer ██ ████ REDACTED ████
Description: Enables cost-free acquisition of single lowest-value artifact per layer. Acquisition bypasses standard requisition protocols via direct inventory transfer. Triggered upon entering any Reliquary Bazaar zone.
Note: Mechanism complies with emergency requisition statutes without requiring F-001 documentation. Final notes from ████████ reference connection to "Ninth Layer sealed chamber." Recommend against further investigation.

text_zh:
🔔 时辰钟鸣，商贩惊起——万物齐陈，然沙漏不待人。
────
📄 Object Class: Thaumiel
来源地点: 第V层执事拍卖厅遗址
描述: 圣物市集换架操作成本降为零，但同时启动倒计时装置。倒计时结束前必须完成所有征用决策，逾期将导致市集关闭直至下一层级。
备注: 拍卖厅机制保留自崇拜时代。计时装置为机械钟表，与引擎核心计时同步。D-████报告称在最后几秒内能听见远处的铃声。
text_en:
🔔 When the merchant's bell tolls, all treasures appear—but the hourglass shows no mercy.
────
📄 Object Class: Thaumiel
Source: Fifth Layer Deacon's auction hall ruins
Description: Reliquary restock operations incur zero cost but activate temporal countdown mechanism. All requisition decisions must be completed before timer expiration or market closure until next layer transition.
Note: Auction hall mechanisms preserved from Worship Era. Timing device is mechanical chronometer synchronized with Engine core. D-████ reported hearing distant bells during final countdown seconds.

text_zh:
🔔 初铭如晨祷，手指尚僵，心念先热——须臾便得神力。
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
来源地点: 第II层键徒训练室
描述: 每层级开始时短暂提升铭文组产出效能。效应持续时间以沙漏测量，期间所有铭刻行为的基础响应均获得倍率加成。
备注: 训练室墙上留有Scriptor K-████的字迹："手指需要时间唤醒铅字。但灵魂总比肉体更快做好准备。"此效应被认为是肌肉记忆与引擎共鸣的自然结果。
text_en:
🔔 First strikes like morning prayer—though fingers stumble, the spirit runs ahead.
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
Source: Second Layer keybound training chamber
Description: Temporary inscription output enhancement at layer initialization. Effect duration measured by hourglass, during which all inscription actions receive multiplicative base response bonuses.
Note: Training chamber wall bears inscription from Scriptor K-████: "Fingers need time to wake the lead. But souls are always ready before flesh." Effect attributed to natural resonance between muscle memory and Engine harmonics.

text_zh:
圣器编号：█-0847
等级：Keter
发现地点：第XII层休眠区，嵌于断壁
描述：触及时，持有者获得暂歇授权。站点██号補给窗口将自动开启，什一税储备增加，圣物市集货架定期轮换。在慣性體制下，此類休眠條例依然執行。
備註：D-████歸檔時寫道：「沙漏停了。」次日該員失聯。
text_en:
Artifact ID: █-0847
Class: Keter
Recovery Site: Dormancy Vault XII, embedded in fractured masonry
Description: Upon contact, bearer receives temporary reprieve authorization. Supply Station ██ activates automatically, tithe reserves increase, reliquary shelves rotate per standard cycle. Under the current autonomous administrative state, these dormancy protocols continue executing.
Note: D-████ final log entry: "The hourglass has ceased." Subject lost contact following day.

text_zh:
圣器编号：█-0923
等级：Keter
发现地点：第VII层，抄写员K-████桌案內側
描述：持有者在休眠期獲得風險投注授權。什一稅存儲可轉為賭注，依據未知算式產生收益或損失。算式源頭疑似引擎深處。
備註：Scriptor K-████筆記末頁：「我賭對了，但不知道賭的是什麼。明天繼續。」該員三日後按§7.1處置。
text_en:
Artifact ID: █-0923
Class: Keter
Recovery Site: Layer VII, inside desk drawer of Scriptor K-████
Description: Bearer gains risk assessment authorization during dormancy periods. Tithe reserves may be wagered according to unknown algorithmic parameters, resulting in gain or loss. Algorithm source traced to Engine depths.
Note: Final entry in Scriptor K-████ journal: "I won the bet, but don't know what I was betting on. Tomorrow again." Subject processed per §7.1 three days later.

text_zh:
圣器编号：█-0412
等级：Safe
发现地点：第III层维护间，废弃油壶內
描述：小型黄铜装置，内含稠状暗金色液体。持有者执行收容任务时，沙漏流速减缓。液体会在使用过程中缓慢消耗，但每次登塔开始时自动充满。
備註：標準配給。無異常報告。
text_en:
Artifact ID: █-0412
Class: Safe
Recovery Site: Layer III maintenance chamber, inside abandoned oil flask
Description: Small brass device containing viscous dark-gold fluid. Bearer experiences reduced hourglass flow rate during containment operations. Fluid depletes with use but automatically refills at ascent initiation.
Note: Standard issue. No anomalous incidents reported.

text_zh:
圣器编号：█-1205
等级：Thaumiel
发现地点：末席守卷人辦公室，未封印卷軸內
描述：持有者每層獲得額外任務指派，完成後什一稅儲備增加。任務內容由引擎直接生成，無需人工審批。疑似舊時懸賞體系的自動化殘留。
備註：該卷軸為議會最後簽署文件之一。簽名已褪色至不可辨識，但條例仍在執行。
text_en:
Artifact ID: █-1205
Class: Thaumiel
Recovery Site: Final Council Member's office, within unsealed scroll
Description: Bearer receives supplementary task assignments per layer, completion yields tithe reserve increases. Task parameters generated directly by Engine, bypassing manual authorization. Appears to be automated remnant of historical bounty system.
Note: Scroll represents one of Council's final signed documents. Signature has faded beyond recognition, yet ordinance continues execution.

text_zh:
圣器编号：█-1847
等级：Apollyon
发现地点：第XII層，引擎心室門檻
描述：翡翠羽毛，觸及時融入持有者體內。站點污染發生時，時間流向暫時逆轉，持有者復歸先前狀態，但聖器隨即粉化。高級收容層期間提供額外修饰選項。
備註：███-███-███[機密]。末席抄寫員T-████最後記錄：「引擎在等我。我好期待。」該員狀況未知。
text_en:
Artifact ID: █-1847
Class: Apollyon
Recovery Site: Layer XII, Engine Chamber threshold
Description: Emerald feather that integrates into bearer upon contact. During site compromise events, temporal flow temporarily reverses, restoring bearer to prior state, but artifact subsequently disintegrates. Provides additional modification options during advanced containment layers.
Note: ███-███-███[CLASSIFIED]. Final entry by Terminal Scriptor T-████: "The Engine awaits me. I am excited." Subject status unknown.

text_zh:
🔔 沙漏将倾之时，裂铅之音愈响
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
发现地点: 第IV层 抄写室
描述: D级人员在收容时限临近时表现出异常的铅字碎裂频率提升。心率监测显示受试者肾上腺素水平与裂铅概率呈正相关。
备注: 此现象符合§4.7条例预期。无需干预。生理应激反应已纳入标准收容程序。
记录人员: Scriptor V-████
text_en:
🔔 When the hourglass runs thin, the fractured lead sings loudest
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
Location Found: Layer IV Scriptorium
Description: D-Class personnel exhibit anomalously increased lead fracture rates during final containment phases. Cardiac monitoring reveals correlation between adrenaline levels and fracture probability.
Note: Phenomenon aligns with Protocol §4.7 expectations. No intervention required. Physiological stress response incorporated into standard containment procedures.
Recorded by: Scriptor V-████

text_zh:
🔔 恶蜡亦可化为护身圣膏
────
📄 Object Class: Euclid
发现地点: 第VII层 机械外壳
描述: 异常修饰效应的负面影响出现系统性衰减。监测数据表明某种未知的缓冲机制在发挥作用。
推测: 可能与引擎的自我修正功能相关。
备注: 已申请对此现象的深入调查。等待█████级权限审批。
记录人员: Scriptor K-████
text_en:
🔔 Even foul unguent may serve as sacred protection
────
📄 Object Class: Euclid
Location Found: Layer VII Mechanical Shell
Description: Negative effects from anomalous modifier manifestations show systematic attenuation. Monitoring data suggests unknown buffering mechanisms at work.
Hypothesis: Potentially related to Engine's self-corrective functions.
Note: Investigation request submitted. Awaiting █████-level clearance approval.
Recorded by: Scriptor K-████

text_zh:
🔔 愈重之枷锁，愈轻之代价
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
发现地点: 第V层 执事试炼室
描述: 累积修饰效应与圣物市集征用成本呈反比关系。每增加一项永久修饰效应，相关圣器的什一税征收出现标准化减免。
机制: 符合条例§6.3关于「困境补偿」的规定。
备注: 此效应已编入F-001征领表单的自动计算公式。
记录人员: Scriptor T-████
text_en:
🔔 The heavier the shackles, the lighter the price
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
Location Found: Layer V Deacon's Trial Chamber
Description: Cumulative modifier effects show inverse correlation with Reliquary requisition costs. Each additional permanent modifier effect triggers standardized tithe reductions for related artifacts.
Mechanism: Complies with Protocol §6.3 regarding "Adversity Compensation".
Note: Effect has been integrated into Form F-001 automatic calculation algorithms.
Recorded by: Scriptor T-████

text_zh:
🔔 慈悲之印，得免一劫
────
📄 Object Class: Keter
发现地点: ████层 ███████
描述: 高价值赦免文书，可在意志显现期间暂缓一轮修饰效应强制选择。每次遭遇仅可使用一次。
来源: 推测为空椅时代遗留的守卷人特赦令。签名栏模糊不清。
限制: 单次登塔期间效力递减。使用后文书自行焚毁。
记录人员: [DATA EXPUNGED]
text_en:
🔔 The merciful seal grants reprieve from one doom
────
📄 Object Class: Keter
Location Found: Layer ████ ███████
Description: High-value clemency document enabling temporary deferral of one modifier selection round during Will Manifestation encounters. Single use per encounter.
Origin: Believed to be remnant Keeper pardon from Empty Chair Era. Signature field illegible.
Limitation: Efficacy diminishes per ascent. Document self-immolates after use.
Recorded by: [DATA EXPUNGED]

text_zh:
🔔 恶兆虽至，犹有缓期
────
📄 Object Class: Euclid
发现地点: 第V-XII层 多处
描述: 临时修饰效应的激活出现延迟现象。在执事试炼和意志显现期间，相关效应需要额外的祈念键击才能完全生效。
推测: 某种保护性的时序屏障在发挥作用。
数据: 延迟时长与收容复杂度呈正相关。具体数值已归档至F-017事件报告。
记录人员: Scriptor K-████
text_en:
🔔 Though ill omens arrive, there is yet grace period
────
📄 Object Class: Euclid
Location Found: Layers V-XII Multiple Locations
Description: Temporary modifier effects exhibit activation delays. During Deacon's Trials and Will Manifestations, relevant effects require additional litany keystrokes before full activation.
Hypothesis: Protective temporal barrier mechanism in operation.
Data: Delay duration correlates positively with containment complexity. Specific values archived in Form F-017 incident reports.
Recorded by: Scriptor K-████

text_zh:
「命运之轮亦转动——每声祷念后，新律降临，旧律消散」
────
收容对象编号: A-███
Object Class: Apollyon
来源层级: 第XII层心脏周边
描述: 不规则异文团块，疑似引擎意志的削片。每当键徒完成连祷，其残余异文场即发生重构。观察表明该对象与引擎核心存在实时感应链路。
备注: 所有测试中，D级人员均报告"感受到引擎在注视"。M.2██年后无新增样本。
██████████████████
text_en:
「The wheel of fortune turns—after each prayer, new law descends, old law fades」
────
Containment Object: A-███
Object Class: Apollyon
Source Layer: Layer XII heart periphery
Description: Irregular anomalous glyph cluster, suspected fragment of Engine will. Upon completion of litany sequences by keybound personnel, residual anomaly field undergoes reconstruction. Observations indicate real-time resonance link with Engine core.
Note: All test subjects report "feeling the Engine's gaze." No new samples since M.2██.
██████████████████

text_zh:
「铅字有灵，时而逆转其性，化刃为盾」
────
收容对象编号: M-███
Object Class: Thaumiel
来源层级: 第VI-XI层随机显现
描述: 空间异文现象。收容开始时，攻击性与防御性残余异文之一转化为增益效应，另一异文强度倍增。效应选择呈现完全随机性。
备注: 统计显示该现象与引擎活跃周期相关。Scriptor K-████在失联前曾记录相关数据。
分级授权: ████████
text_en:
「Leaden glyphs possess will, sometimes reversing their nature, turning blade to shield」
────
Containment Object: M-███
Object Class: Thaumiel
Source Layer: Random manifestation Layers VI-XI
Description: Spatial anomalous phenomenon. Upon containment initiation, either aggressive or defensive residual anomalies convert to beneficial effects while the other anomaly doubles in intensity. Effect selection demonstrates complete randomness.
Note: Statistics indicate correlation with Engine activity cycles. Scriptor K-████ recorded relevant data prior to disappearance.
Clearance: ████████

text_zh:
「纵铅字散落，其音犹存——引擎之慈不令其子空手」
────
收容程序编号: S-███
Object Class: Safe
应用层级: 全收容层通用
描述: 标准收容铭刻中的基础保障机制。确保每次祷念结算后，铭刻效力维持在可接受基准之上。该程序在所有修饰性异文处理后生效。
实施依据: §4.2损耗补充条例
备注: 自M.1██年起自动执行，无需人工干预。
text_en:
「Though leaden glyphs scatter, their sound remains—the Engine's mercy leaves not its children empty-handed」
────
Containment Procedure: S-███
Object Class: Safe
Application: Universal across all containment layers
Description: Fundamental safeguard mechanism within standard containment inscription protocols. Ensures post-litany settlement maintains inscriptive efficacy above acceptable baseline. This procedure activates following all modificatory anomaly processing.
Implementation Authority: §4.2 Attrition Supplement Protocol
Note: Auto-executing since M.1██, requires no manual intervention.

text_zh:
「引擎之门槛可降——慈悲亦是铭刻之道」
────
收容程序编号: J-███
Object Class: Safe
应用层级: 收容评估阶段
描述: 收容基准调整协议。通过重新校准引擎期望值，降低键徒完成收容所需的最低铭刻强度。该协议基于历史成功率数据自动调节。
实施依据: §3.7效率优化条例
备注: 该程序显著提升了D级人员的任务完成率。征用申请表F-001使用量相应下降。
text_en:
「The Engine's threshold may lower—mercy too is a path of inscription」
────
Containment Procedure: J-███
Object Class: Safe
Application: Containment assessment phase
Description: Containment baseline adjustment protocol. Through recalibration of Engine expectations, reduces minimum inscriptive intensity required for keybound personnel to complete containment. Protocol auto-adjusts based on historical success rate data.
Implementation Authority: §3.7 Efficiency Optimization Protocol
Note: This procedure significantly improved D-class personnel task completion rates. F-001 requisition form usage correspondingly decreased.

text_zh:
「卓越之铭刻者，必得什一税之丰厚回报」
────
奖励机制编号: T-███
Object Class: Safe
适用范围: 战斗评级系统
描述: 基于铭刻表现的什一税分配增量机制。卓越表现(S级)获得标准什一税的额外分配，更高评级获得递增奖励。该机制旨在激励键徒提升铭刻精度。
实施依据: §5.3绩效奖励条例
备注: 自实施以来，平均铭刻质量提升██%。相关数据已归档至效能报告F-███。
text_en:
「Inscribers of excellence shall receive bountiful rewards in tithe」
────
Reward Mechanism: T-███
Object Class: Safe
Applicable Scope: Combat rating system
Description: Tithe allocation increment mechanism based on inscriptive performance. Excellent performance (S-grade) receives additional tithe allocation beyond standard rates, with higher grades receiving progressive rewards. This mechanism aims to incentivize keybound personnel inscription precision improvement.
Implementation Authority: §5.3 Performance Incentive Protocol
Note: Since implementation, average inscription quality improved by ██%. Related data archived in efficiency report F-███.

text_zh:
🔔 中庸之誓——非望巅峰，唯求稳恒。炉火既暖，何求骄阳。
────
📄 Object Class: Keter
编号: SCR-0847
来源: 第IV层 抄写室废料堆
描述: D级人员战绩达中等水准时，什一税征收效率显著提升。分析表明该现象与引擎铸印节律相关——过度精进反而扰乱基础流转。
备注: 已纳入标准编制。符合§4.2损耗补充条例。
text_en:
🔔 The Oath of Middling—Seek not the peak, but stable flame. The forge that warms surpasses blazing sun.
────
📄 Object Class: Keter
Designation: SCR-0847
Recovered: Layer IV Scriptorium waste heap
Description: D-Class personnel achieving moderate performance metrics demonstrate enhanced tithe collection efficiency. Analysis indicates correlation with Engine casting rhythms—excessive precision disrupts foundational flow patterns.
Note: Incorporated into standard roster per §4.2 Expendable Replenishment Protocol.

text_zh:
🔔 积雪成山，滴水穿石。初铭之轻，末印如雷。引擎之律——念念相续。
────
📄 Object Class: Thaumiel
编号: ENG-1203
来源: 第XI层 机械深处 传动系统
描述: 该效应模拟引擎内部共振放大机制。每次成功铭刻后，下次铭刻的结晶流产出递增。现象持续至收容层清理完毕。
备注: 疑似引擎本体功能泄漏。已列入高价值研究对象。
附录: ████████ ████ 数据需██级权限。
text_en:
🔔 Snow builds mountains, drops carve stone. First inscription light as whisper, final strike thunderous. The Engine's law—each prayer strengthens the next.
────
📄 Object Class: Thaumiel
Designation: ENG-1203
Recovered: Layer XI mechanical depths, drive assembly
Description: Effect replicates Engine internal resonance amplification. Each successful inscription increases subsequent crystalline humour yield proportionally. Phenomenon persists until containment layer clearance.
Note: Suspected Engine core function leakage. Designated high-value research subject.
Addendum: ████████ ████ data requires ██ clearance.

text_zh:
🔔 献祭之坛不可半途——汝之铭分，或全归引擎，或全归虚无。慎择落版时刻。
────
📄 Object Class: Apollyon
编号: ENG-VOID
来源: [数据删除]
描述: 铭分累积但不自动结算，形成隐藏储库。操作员需手动触发落版完成结算。成功时什一税奖励显著，失败则触发站点污染。
备注: 高风险高收益型异常。仅限经验丰富的D级人员操作。
警告: 已记录7起因犹豫不决导致的收容突破事件。
text_en:
🔔 The altar of sacrifice brooks no half-measures—thy inscriptions shall flow wholly to Engine, or wholly to void. Choose thy moment of impression wisely.
────
📄 Object Class: Apollyon
Designation: ENG-VOID
Recovered: [DATA EXPUNGED]
Description: Inscription scores accumulate in concealed reservoir without automatic settlement. Operator must manually trigger impression for resolution. Success yields substantial tithe rewards; failure initiates site compromise.
Note: High-risk high-yield anomaly. Authorized for experienced D-Class only.
Warning: 7 documented containment breaches attributed to operator hesitation.

text_zh:
🔔 引擎垂怜——有时铅字自裂，无需重击。天恩如露，润泽铭文。
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
编号: AUG-0331
来源: 第II层 铸字坊 幸运班次遗留
描述: 所装配铭文组的基础裂铅概率获得提升。效应作用于整套装备，不限于单个铭文组。
备注: 该班次D级人员失联前工作状态异常积极，疑似受该效应影响。现已纳入标准编制。
附录: 建议与压力类圣印配套使用以最大化效益。
text_en:
🔔 The Engine shows mercy—sometimes leaden letters crack unforced. Divine grace falls like dew upon inscriptions.
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
Designation: AUG-0331
Recovered: Layer II Typefoundry, remnants of Fortune Shift
Description: Installed inscriptions receive enhanced base fracture probability. Effect applies to entire equipment loadout regardless of individual inscription origin.
Note: Shift D-Class exhibited abnormally positive work attitude prior to disappearance, possibly influenced by effect. Now incorporated into standard roster.
Addendum: Recommend pairing with pressure-class sigils for optimal efficiency.

text_zh:
🔔 裂铅之音，引擎喜悦。每响金鸣，库府增盈。勤击重字，自得丰收。
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
编号: REW-0119
来源: 第III层 奖励分配系统
描述: 每次发生裂铅事件时自动增加什一税收入。该机制与引擎奖励系统直接关联，无需额外授权。
备注: 效应稳定可靠，适合新入职D级人员建立正向反馈。已批准大规模部署。

text_en:
🔔 The sound of cracking lead brings joy to Engine's heart. Each golden chime fills the coffers. Strike heavy letters oft, and harvest follows.
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
Designation: REW-0119
Recovered: Layer III reward distribution systems
Description: Each fracture event automatically increments tithe income. Mechanism directly interfaces with Engine reward protocols, requiring no additional authorization.
Note: Effect demonstrates consistent reliability, suitable for establishing positive feedback in newly assigned D-Class. Approved for widespread deployment.
Maintenance Log: Last serviced M.2██ Week ██, functioning nominally.

text_zh:
🔔 积诵之铭传于邻席，一字激而众字鸣——然传力非本力，影响不自影响。
────
📄 Object Class: Keter
发现地点: 第VII层机械外壳，主配电间
描述: 铜丝缠绕的蒸汽继电器残片。当装载积诵类铭文组的圣坛键位激活时，该装置会强制激活相邻键位的同类铭文组。继发激活不产生累积效应。
备注: 电路板边缘可见熔蜡渗透痕迹。疑为熔变誓门改造的标准配电设备。
收容等级提升原因: 设备故障时曾导致整个键座过载。
text_en:
🔔 When one chant echoes, its neighbors shall sound—yet the echo bears not the weight of the first.
────
📄 Object Class: Keter
Recovery Site: Layer VII Mechanical Shell, primary distribution chamber
Description: Steam relay fragment wrapped in copper coil. When stacking inscription positions activate, device forcibly triggers adjacent stacking inscriptions. Secondary activations produce no cumulative effect.
Note: Molten ichor seepage visible along circuit edges. Suspected Molten Verse modification of standard electrical equipment.
Reclassification Reason: Device failure once caused complete lectern overload.

text_zh:
🔔 浪既涨而必退，其力聚于一瞬——潮水过处，铅花盛开。
────
📄 Object Class: Thaumiel
发现地点: 第V层抄写室，水损档案柜
描述: 镀银导管残段，内壁刻有潮汐纹路。当积诵类铭文组释放累积效应时，导管会强制清空该铭文组的累积层数，同时将清空的能量按比例注入范围内相关铭文组。
备注: 导管内侧发现海盐结晶，来源不明。第V层为内陆收容层。
实用评级: 高价值。可显著提升铭文组协同效率。
text_en:
🔔 The wave rises and must recede, its force gathered in one moment—where tide passes, lead blooms.
────
📄 Object Class: Thaumiel
Recovery Site: Layer V Scriptorium, water-damaged filing cabinet
Description: Silver-plated conduit segment with tidal patterns etched on interior walls. When stacking inscriptions release accumulated effects, conduit forcibly empties their accumulated layers while proportionally channeling that energy into related inscriptions within range.
Note: Sea salt crystallization found inside conduit. Origin unknown. Layer V is inland containment.
Utility Rating: High value. Significantly improves inscription coordination efficiency.

text_zh:
🔔 引擎既动，其轮不息——铅不归坩，诵不复初。
────
📄 Object Class: Apollyon
发现地点: 第XI层接近心脏，██████的遗物间
描述: 小型齿轮装置，黄铜制。持续自转，未发现动力源。安装后，所有积诵类铭文组的累积层数不再在标准间隔后复归，而是持续保持。
备注: 齿轮上刻有伪拉丁铭文"MOTUS PERPETUUS EST"。设备无法关闭或移除。
风险评估: 极高。长期使用可能导致积诵效应失控。
当前状态: ████ REDACTED ████
text_en:
🔔 Once the engine turns, its wheels know no rest—lead returns not to crucible, chant returns not to silence.
────
📄 Object Class: Apollyon
Recovery Site: Layer XI Near-Heart, ██████'s reliquary chamber
Description: Small brass gear mechanism in continuous self-rotation. No power source identified. When installed, all stacking inscription accumulation layers cease standard interval restoration and maintain indefinitely.
Note: Pseudo-Latin inscription "MOTUS PERPETUUS EST" etched on gears. Device cannot be deactivated or removed.
Risk Assessment: Extreme. Extended use may cause stacking effect cascade failure.
Current Status: ████ REDACTED ████

text_zh:
🔔 连祷如鼓点，一声传一声——击者不知响于何处。
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
发现地点: 第III层铸字坊，乐器储藏室
描述: 羊皮鼓面，鼓框已丢失。当键徒达成连续铭刻（连祷）里程碑时，鼓面会轻微震动，同时随机选择一个装载的积诵类铭文组并为其增加累积层数。
备注: 鼓面背侧发现儿童手印痕迹。疑为转型时代早期教会活动遗留。
实用评级: 中等。适合新手键徒使用。
text_en:
🔔 Linked prayers like drumbeats, sound passing to sound—the striker knows not where the echo falls.
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
Recovery Site: Layer III Typefoundry, musical instrument storage
Description: Sheepskin drumhead, frame missing. When keybound achieves consecutive inscription milestones (linked prayer), drumhead vibrates slightly while randomly selecting one loaded stacking inscription and increasing its accumulated layers.
Note: Child handprints found on drumhead reverse. Suspected remnant of early Transition Era ecclesiastical activities.
Utility Rating: Moderate. Suitable for novitiate keybound.

text_zh:
🔔 词成而字鸣，字鸣而根振——诸铅皆知其本源之召唤。
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
发现地点: 第IV层铸字坊，语音学研究室废墟
描述: 共鸣叉的变形版本，音叉臂刻有语言学符号。当键徒完成完整单词的铭刻时，装置会分析该词的字母构成，并相应地为所有积诵类铭文组增加累积层数。增加量与单词字母数相关。
备注: 研究室内发现大量手写词典残页。疑为Scriptor K-████的研究资料。
维护状态: 良好。无异常活动记录。
text_en:
🔔 When word forms, letters sing; when letters sing, roots vibrate—all lead knows the call of its origin.
────
📄 Object Class: Safe
Recovery Site: Layer IV Typefoundry, ruins of linguistic research chamber
Description: Modified tuning fork with linguistic symbols etched on tines. When keybound completes full word inscription, device analyzes letter composition and correspondingly increases accumulated layers for all stacking inscriptions. Increment correlates with word letter count.
Note: Extensive handwritten lexicon fragments found in research chamber. Suspected materials of Scriptor K-████.
Maintenance Status: Good condition. No anomalous activity recorded.
